content.title: Fix: dashboard fetches only root issues and lazy-loads children
content.description:
Implement the frontend-only fix so the Issues dashboard shows only root issues and lazy-loads children on expand.

Context (from investigation, already verified):
- Backend already supports `GET /api/issues?parentId=null` (roots only) and `?parentId=<id>` (children). No backend/library change is needed.
- The API client (`packages/webapp/frontend/src/api/issues.ts`) already serializes parentId (including null).

Required changes (all in the webapp frontend):

1. `packages/webapp/frontend/src/components/issues/IssueList.tsx` (and/or `pages/IssuesPage.tsx`): the dashboard list MUST request only root issues by default. Ensure the issues query is issued with `parentId: null` when no explicit parent filter is set by the user, so only top-level issues render in the tree. Do NOT drop the user's other filters (status/assignee/tags/search) — combine them with parentId=null for the top-level query.

2. `packages/webapp/frontend/src/components/issues/IssueTree.tsx` `IssueTreeRow`: currently calls `useIssues(expanded ? { parentId: issue.id } : {})`. When collapsed this fetches the entire issue list on EVERY row. Fix it so a collapsed row does NOT fetch all issues — e.g. keep the query disabled while collapsed (use the query's enabled flag, or query `{ parentId: issue.id }` only and gate with enabled=expanded). Keep the existing correct behavior when expanded (lazy-load children by parentId).

Acceptance criteria:
- Dashboard initially shows only root issues (no parent).
- Expanding a parent lazily loads ONLY its direct children via parentId.
- Collapsed rows do not trigger an all-issues fetch.
- Existing filters (status, assignee, tags, search) continue to work on the top-level list.
- Children are no longer duplicated at the top level.

Add a comment summarizing the changes and any decisions.

content.reason: Blocker issue mqgsyjo9c7 transitioned to done

content.content:
Done. Implemented the frontend-only fix so the dashboard shows only root issues and lazy-loads children on expand.

Changes (all in packages/webapp/frontend/src):
1. hooks/use-issues.ts — added an optional `options.enabled` flag to `useIssues` so callers can gate the query (defaults to true; preserves existing call sites in SubIssuesSection, ParentSelector, BlockagesSection).
2. components/issues/IssueList.tsx — the dashboard list now merges the user's filters with `parentId: null`, so only top-level issues render. Existing status/assignee/tags/search filters are preserved and combined with the root-only filter.
3. components/issues/IssueTree.tsx (IssueTreeRow) — children are always queried via `{ parentId: issue.id }` but the query is now gated with `enabled: expanded`. Previously a collapsed row passed `{}` which fetched the entire issue list on every row; that no longer happens.

Decisions:
- Kept the chevron visible on all rows (out of scope to hide it for childless issues — would require a hasChildren signal from the backend, which we don't have without fetching). The issue scope was the fetch behavior, which is fully addressed.
- No backend/library changes needed — the API client already serialized parentId (including null).

Verification:
- tsc --noEmit: clean
- Frontend production build (tsc -b + vite build): success
- Full Playwright e2e suite: 152/152 passing (Phase 1 covers the issues list)

Acceptance criteria met: dashboard initially shows only roots; expanding lazy-loads direct children via parentId; collapsed rows do not trigger all-issues fetch; existing filters continue to work on the top-level list; children are no longer duplicated at the top level.
